title: Hollywood depictions of the jazz era
summary: Cheatham says films about the era, including the Armstrong television show, do not tell the true story.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: How do you feel when you see Hollywood movies that depict that era, say, well not talking about "Lady Sings the Blues," necessarily, did you see the television show with Ben Vereen playing Louis Armstrong?
I didn't see that. But I heard so much about it.
That -- but that it wasn't done properly, so much of it was --
No, it was pretty awful. But you've seen movies --
-- about the gangsters and the clubs and --
Oh yes. Oh, they don't tell the true story all the time.
They leave most of the important things out of those films.
